flash_690557.description: If the State Department itself warns about Hamas financing and Russian missiles, why is Washington still debating advanced fighter aircraft for Turkey? Opinion.

flash_690556.description: Wave of antisemitic incidents in Manchester: Haredi residents’ cars vandalized days after three Jews shot with air gun.

flash_690554.description: Northern District police arrested a 39-year-old Maghar resident suspected of incitement after allegedly posting an inflammatory comment on social media following the Havat Gilad attack.

flash_690555.description: Political commentator Amit Segal addressed the reactions to the terrorist attack in which Benayahu Melet and Maj. Yuval Ezra were murdered and harshly criticized members of the Democrats party.

flash_690553.description: French security services have arrested six suspects accused of planning a terrorist attack targeting a synagogue, in the latest in a series of serious security incidents in the country.

flash_690551.description: Security officials say they are detecting a shift in Arab behavior and are warning of the possibility of a broad popular uprising following the terrorist attacks over the past week.

flash_690549.description: Minister Smotrich appeals to IDF Chief following dismissal of soldier who posted video supporting his party: 'Punishment is disproportionate. Reinstate soldier to active service.'

flash_690558.description: Seven Palestinian Arab suspects were arrested last night on suspicion of involvement in a violent incident near the Moreno farm, in the Beitar Illit area.

flash_690552.description: Mother of detained Tal Yinon Derdik speaks to Dr. Chana Katan, launching a blistering attack on authorities and revealing details of his hunger strike and harsh detention reality.

flash_690550.description: 170 members of the Religious Zionism Party's central committee will decide today among ten candidates seeking to secure a place on the party's Knesset slate.

flash_690561.description: The Government approved Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s proposal to ban the import into Israel of goods produced, entirely or in part, through forced labor.

flash_690560.description: Forty-eight years since the birth of the world’s first IVF baby, Prof. Shlomo Mashiach, pioneer of fertility medicine in Israel who helped transform global revolution in reproductive medicine into tangible hope for countless couples, passed away.

flash_690559.description: After the Dutchban on imports from Judea and Samaria, Geert Wilders, the candidate for the Dutch presidency, arrived in Israel as the guest of the head of the Samaria Council.

flash_690562.description: At the beginning of the cabinet meeting, the Prime Minister said that he would meet with President Trump in Washington.

flash_690567.description: Defense Minister Israel Katz commented on the stabbing attack near Elon Moreh in which Itamar Cohen was wounded, wishing him a speedy recovery and praising the security forces for swiftly eliminating the terrorists. Katz said Palestinian terrorism has declined by more than 80% due to Israel's offensive policy but remains a threat. He vowed the IDF would continue operating throughout Judea and Samaria and said terrorism would not deter Israel from strengthening settlement and security in the region.

flash_690566.description: German authorities have arrested an Iranian citizen on suspicion of involvement in the rampage attack at the Berlin Pride parade in which one person was killed and about 20 were injured.

flash_690564.description: President of Syria Ahmed al-Sharaa says that his country is working to reach a security agreement with Israel, involving additional countries, which could pave the way for comprehensive peace, without giving up the Golan.'
